main.description: Deprecated: replaced by id.skiddle.page (key home). The home page's own text: the intro, the selected work, the hire box and the links. One record, key 'self'. A field left out shows the built-in text (src/data/home.ts). Now, the posts and the testimonials come from their own records.

title.description: The page's title, in the browser tab and in search results.

description.description: What search results and link previews say about the site.

tagline.description: The line under the heading, in the accent colour.

intro.description: Under the heading. Markdown, rendered like a post's text: paragraphs, links, bold and italics.

selectedProjects.description: Selected work: id.skiddle.project records to show, in order.

elsewhere.description: The links at the bottom, after 'Elsewhere:'.

hire.description: The box asking people to work with Jeff. Its buttons stay as they are.

href.description: A path on skiddle.id, e.g. /rss.xml, or a full URL: https://… or mailto:….

me.description: One of Jeff's own profiles (rel="me"), so the profile can check it links back here.
